observations.title: Particle Rain role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use normal rain, snow and weather while the client renders the configured particle effects.
observations.outcome: Replaces client weather presentation with configurable particles and keeps dedicated-server execution inactive.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata and Forge entry-point bytecode were inspected.
Upstream 4.0.3 reports compatibility and texture-corruption fixes, but this pack's exact renderer combination still requires player acceptance.
observations.review_note: The exact Forge artifact exits before registration on a dedicated server, so JEM installs it only in the managed client.
